used_myths: Exercising during your period is unsafe and damages female reproductive health.
Infertility is solely a female problem and men do not experience reproductive health issues.
Taking daily oral contraceptive pills causes permanent infertility in women later in life.
The hymen is an intact seal that breaks and bleeds during first sexual intercourse.
Using oral contraceptive pills eliminates the need to use condoms during sexual intercourse.
Men do not need emotional intimacy or affection to experience sexual desire or relationship satisfaction.
Breastfeeding naturally prevents pregnancy, making other forms of contraception unnecessary during the postpartum period.
Intimate areas require scented soaps or douching to maintain proper hygiene.
Period blood is dirty, impure waste that detoxifies a woman's body every month.
Elevating your legs after intercourse is essential for sperm to reach the egg and achieve successful conception.
Getting a vasectomy causes a loss of physical strength, sexual drive, and masculinity in men.
Women urinate and give birth through the same bodily opening.
You can tell if a partner has an STI just by looking at their physical appearance.
True love means your partner instinctively knows your intimate and emotional desires without explicit communication.
Postpartum depression is merely temporary emotional weakness that resolves on its own without professional medical intervention.
Masturbation causes severe physical weakness, hair loss, and vision impairment in young individuals.
You cannot get pregnant if you have sexual intercourse during your period.
Irregular periods mean a woman is completely infertile and cannot conceive a child naturally.
Emergency contraceptive pills can be used as a routine, primary method of birth control.
